name: dynamic_browser_agent
description: Use an observe-plan-act loop with Agent Browser snapshots and safe JSON actions instead of hardcoded browser scripts.
rules: Always take or use the latest accessibility snapshot before choosing a browser action.
Choose one safe action at a time: open, snapshot, find, fill, click, wait, scroll, press, extract_product_data, note, or finish.
Use hints from labels, roles, placeholders, button text, and nearby context when refs are not known.
After any click, navigation, wait, or dynamic page change, request a fresh snapshot before using new refs.
Store useful findings in swarm memory so the next agent can continue from structured data instead of prose.
For supplier sourcing, prefer products with meaningful review/order volume and strong ratings over perfect ratings with tiny sample sizes.
For admin upload, map product data to fields by meaning, not by fixed page order.
